subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: After the session-accessor boundary blocker is fixed, should this PR be the canonical implementation for the durable main-session restart-recovery fuse and tombstone contract?
rationale: The patch changes persisted recovery state and intentional availability behavior, and there is another open candidate for the same issue, so automation should not choose the shipped contract by itself.

options.title: Fix Boundary Then Land This Contract
options.body: Repair the session-accessor violation, keep the mainRestartRecovery fuse semantics, and land this PR as the canonical fix for the production restart-loop issue.

options.title: Require More Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for one more supervised restart proof if the current file-backed runtime output plus Mantis Telegram proof is not enough for the availability risk.

options.title: Prefer The Other Candidate
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if maintainers choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96083 as the viable canonical landing path.

recommendation.title: Fix Boundary Then Land This Contract
recommendation.body: Repair the session-accessor violation, keep the mainRestartRecovery fuse semantics, and land this PR as the canonical fix for the production restart-loop issue.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned reviewer and authored the maintainer direction that shaped the current recovery-fuse implementation.
